description: Expander adding channels 7 to 16 to Maestro: ten more rows of input, probability, mode and output, tied to a Maestro chosen on this module's own right-click menu rather than by position

params.text: Sets that channel's weight in the linked Maestro's draw, 0 for never chosen and 1 for most likely
Crossfades that channel's weight between its PROB knob and its PROB CV jack: fully anticlockwise the knob alone, fully clockwise the voltage alone
Sets what that channel does when it is chosen: F fades its input up and down over the linked Maestro's fade times, G switches it through at once, T sends a short pulse

inputs.text: Sets that channel's weight from a voltage, 0V to 10V; how far it overrides the PROB knob is set by that channel's PROB XFADE
The signal that channel passes while it is on; with nothing patched it reads the fixed voltage set on the linked Maestro's menu

outputs.text: That channel's input while the channel is on and silence while it is off, with the fade or the trigger applied, carrying as many channels as its input

notes: this module does nothing until it is linked to a Maestro from its own right-click menu: unlinked, the panel is dimmed and every output stays at 0V
it can go anywhere in the rack, beside its Maestro or not, because the link is made through the menu rather than by position
once linked, the Maestro's ACTIVE TRACKS control reaches 16 and its channels 7 to 16 are the rows on this panel
the name beside each row is an editable label drawn in its own widget, so no help line can be reached by clicking it
every decision is made by the linked Maestro, which reads these knobs and switches and writes these outputs itself; this module holds no clock, evaluation or fade of its own
menu: Link to Core: None, Core — picks which Maestro this expander adds its channels to, listing each by its module number and marking any that another expander has already claimed
